Interdisciplinarian, Mathematician, Curious Lifelong learner.

My Linkedin | My wikipedia page



Graduate of Brigham Young University-Idaho with a Bachelor’s of Interdisciplinary Studies degree, exploring my options, honing my skills, and filling in this portfolio while I work part-time.


Math and Computer Science, particularly where they intersect in the field of Reasoning Systems.



Math, science, philosophy, communication, psychology, etc. I primarily focus on math and logic in my active research, and some political science for a podcast I help run.
